description.text: The fifth expansion of the MEGA series, released on 22 May 2026. Mega Darkrai ex leads it: its attack Abyss Eye knocks out the opponent's Active Pokémon if it is affected by a Special Condition, whatever HP it has left, and Malamar, whose attack Confuses the opponent's Active Pokémon, and Dark Bell, which Confuses both Active Pokémon, help set it up. Mega Zeraora ex, Mega Chandelure ex and Mega Excadrill ex join it, with Pokémon ex such as Morpeko ex, Lurantis ex, Wailord ex and Rampardos ex, and a group of Pokémon, among them Sinistcha, Banette, Dhelmise and Spiritomb, that share an Ability protecting them from the effects of the opponent's attacks and Abilities, and whose attacks depend on how many of them are in the discard pile. The Supporters Gladion's Showdown and Gwynn and the Special Energy Shadowy Darkness Energy and Voltaic Lightning Energy are also in it. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 81, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Trainer cards, Special Art Rare cards, and Mega Darkrai ex as a Mega Ultra Rare. In English most of its cards came out in Pitch Black in July 2026.
